features.name: normalized_credit_score
features.description: Credit score normalized to [0,1] using training min/max range (350 to 850), providing a smooth linear input for SVM margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized credit risk signal directly usable by linear SVM without scale distortion.

features.name: age_risk_score
features.description: Normalized age deviation from the mean (38.07), capturing mid-career vs older customer risk profile on a continuous scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous age-based risk signal normalized for SVM, capturing non-linear age effects via absolute deviation.

features.name: balance_to_salary_ratio
features.description: Log-transformed ratio of balance to estimated salary, capturing relative wealth accumulation. Log1p handles zero balances gracefully.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth log-ratio feature capturing financial stability relative to income, useful for linear separation.

features.name: engagement_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of active membership, credit card ownership, and number of products normalized to [0,1], measuring overall bank engagement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single continuous engagement score combining multiple binary/ordinal signals for linear SVM margin optimization.

features.name: tenure_stability_score
features.description: Tenure normalized by maximum tenure (10), representing customer loyalty duration as a smooth [0,1] score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized tenure signal for linear SVM, capturing long-term customer stability.

features.name: log_balance_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed balance normalized by log of max balance, compressing the heavy-tailed balance distribution for linear models.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skewness in balance distribution, enabling linear SVM to better separate high vs low balance customers.

features.name: germany_high_balance_interaction
features.description: Interaction between Germany geography flag and normalized balance, capturing region-specific financial behavior patterns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures geographic-financial interaction that may be linearly separable in SVM feature space.

features.name: female_age_interaction
features.description: Interaction between female gender indicator and normalized age, capturing gender-age demographic combinations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides linear SVM with a combined demographic signal that may separate risk groups more effectively.

features.name: product_concentration_risk
features.description: Risk score based on number of products: customers with exactly 1 or 3+ products may have different retention profiles. Normalized deviation from optimal 2 products.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear product count risk as a smooth continuous score suitable for linear SVM.

features.name: financial_stress_index
features.description: Composite financial stress measure combining low credit score, high balance-to-salary ratio, and inactive membership into a single severity score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregated financial stress signal providing a smooth composite for linear SVM decision boundary.

features.name: customer_value_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall customer value based on combination of balance level, salary, tenure, and product usage. Higher scores indicate more valuable, potentially harder-to-replace customers. Scored 0 (low value) to 1 (high value).
features.expected_model_benefit: Holistic customer value signal that captures complex interactions not easily expressed in single formulas, useful for SVM margin.

features.name: behavioral_disengagement_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of behavioral disengagement signals: inactive membership, no credit card, single product, and short tenure together indicate disengagement risk. Scored 0 (fully engaged) to 1 (highly disengaged).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nuanced disengagement patterns across multiple behavioral dimensions as a single continuous score for linear SVM.
